records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021 increased by $810.9 million, or 27%, and $7.2 billion, or 114%, compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021 increased by $247.2 million, or 55%, and $847.6 million, or 78%, compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These improvements were mainly as a result of varying states of continued economic recovery and re-openings in the majority of U.S. markets that our customers operate in.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •continued improvements in both card-present volumes as a result of regional re-openings and resumed in-person activity at sellers, as well as growth in higher-priced card-not-present transactions;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, cash provided by operating activities was $672.8 million.
